limitations: The visual review covers56 actual encoded frames and the listed adjacent states, not real-time complete-film viewing.
Numerical source/waveform retention, correlation, loudness, delay and drift checks do not recognize words or validate pronunciation.
Original source pause flags remain preserved and source-bound; numerical correspondence is not a claim of naturalness or semantic listening.
No ASR, human whole-film listening or semantic audio listening was performed.
Website playback, native VTT, controls/fullscreen, delivery and online SHA checks remain separate.

observations.finding: Opening element A is separated from its label after the layout correction. Eight cells visibly contain0 with external indices0–7; later bit-array explanation preserves that distinction. Titles, watermark and burned captions are legible.
Single A path maps to3 while the empty bitmap remains0. At the actual write boundary1225/1226, only bit3 changes0→1 and the written result appears.
B arrives at shared position3. Bit3 remains1; B is added to the demonstration membership only after arrival. The caption/note distinguishes the operation history from stored bitmap contents.
D maps to7=0; the rejection result appears after arrival, with the fixed-rule/correctly-retained-mark premise visible.
C maps to3=1; after arrival the result says only possible. The second sentence changes the explanation to C was never inserted and the mark came from A/B.
Explicit invalid-clear example changes shared bit3 from1 to0 while B remains a real member. The wrong-rejection result appears only after B reads that zero.

Final-source reset occurs at3265, after sentence2 ends at3262.68. Frame3264 retains the wrong rejection;3265 restores bit3=1 and membersA/B with a neutral restore label. The old reset pair was replaced in the final plan.
The independent two-position comparison explicitly starts with all0, without reusing old bit3. A writes3 and then2; membership A appears only after its two writes complete.
B shared3 remains1, then position1 changes0→1. All A/B reinsertion completes before C query begins; the completed bitmap has exactly1/2/3 set.
C first checks3=1 and remains in the checking state. Its subsequent read5=0 produces the stated exclusion of this example, without claiming a measured false-positive rate or universal improvement.

The conclusion visibly returns to the original single-position bitmap with only3 set. D7=0 excludes; switching to C clears the prior result; C3=1 remains only possible. The tradeoff statement and required maintenance premise remain readable.

Last body frame retains its burned caption. Actual reference first/middle/last frames show no body-caption residue; Redis Bloom filter and Apache Cassandra Bloom Filters original titles, exact English excerpts, checked date2026-10-26, and pause-reading prompt remain legible and uncut.
